name: Kubernetes-native MCP governance
tagline: Monitors agentgateway and kagent resources, scores MCP security posture and adds AI risk analysis.
problem: Teams deploying MCP servers have no posture view of how secure their agent infrastructure is.
solution: A Kubernetes-native governance layer that watches gateway and agent resources, scores each MCP server's security posture and explains risks with Gemini or a local Ollama model.

why_it_stood_out.claim: MCP-server-centric scoring model applied to the organizer's own resources.
Offers a local-model option (Ollama), which matters for governance buyers.
